title: Tsup Configuration Options
description: Configuration options for tsup build. This schema defines the options that can be customized when generating a tsup-based package.

sourcemap.description: Generate source maps for debugging. When enabled, creates .map files alongside output files.

splitting.description: Enable code splitting. When enabled, shared code between entry points is split into separate chunks. Useful for reducing bundle size when multiple entry points share code. Note: Only works with ESM format.
